summary_en: Interim dividend of 15.00 yen per share confirmed. Year-end dividend forecast raised from 14.00 yen to 17.00 yen per share, comprising 15.00 yen ordinary dividend and 2.00 yen commemorative dividend marking the 50th anniversary of subsidiary Pickles Corporation. Full-year dividend projected at 32.00 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Increase in Commemorative and Ordinary Dividends)
translation_en_brief:
Pickles Holdings announced modifications to its dividend policy for the fiscal year ending February 2027. The interim dividend was confirmed at 15.00 yen per share, with a record date of August 31, 2026, and effective date of November 5, 2026. The year-end dividend forecast was revised upward from 14.00 yen to 17.00 yen per share, consisting of 15.00 yen in ordinary dividend and 2.00 yen in commemorative dividend, bringing the full-year dividend to 32.00 yen per share.

The company cited two reasons for the increase. First, a commemorative dividend of 2.00 yen was introduced to mark the 50th anniversary of Pickles Corporation, a major subsidiary, in February 2027, as a token of appreciation to shareholders. Second, the ordinary dividend was increased by 1.00 yen as part of the company's fundamental dividend policy of implementing progressive dividends while ensuring sufficient internal reserves for future business development and strengthening of financial position.

The company stated it conducted a comprehensive review of business performance, financial condition, and future business prospects in determining the dividend increase. The revisions represent management's confidence in the company's operational trajectory and reflect a commitment to progressive dividend growth for shareholders.
